## ✅ Implementation complete — Bookmark Manager

All **66 tasks** across all 12 user stories plus the polish phase are done and marked `[x]` in `tasks.md`. The MVP (US1+US2) was validated mid-way as a checkpoint, and I continued through every approved story.

### What was built
A single-user, browser-based bookmark manager — one Node/Express process serving a JSON API + a no-build vanilla-JS SPA, backed by embedded SQLite, with Chromium-based offline capture.

| Story | Delivered |
|---|---|
| US1 Save | Enter URL → **review** auto-collected title/description/favicon/preview → edit → confirm; favicon/preview persist; duplicate opens the existing bookmark; offline copy attempted **after** confirm (non-blocking) |
| US2 Browse/find | Rich rows (title/description/tags/favicon), title+address link to the original page, sort by date/title, advanced search (phrases, `#tag`, `AND`/`OR`/`NOT`/brackets, quoted-operator-as-literal) |
| US3–US7 | Read-later + unread view; edit/delete with confirm; tags with type-ahead + tag filter; bulk actions incl. "select all matching"; reversible archive with its own view |
| US8–US12 | Formatted notes (sanitized); saved filters (search + include/exclude tags); offline copy viewing + PDF-as-PDF + optional Internet Archive; browser HTML import/export (titles/tags/dates); display preferences (sort/density/text size) |

### Verification (run, not claimed)
- **21/21 unit tests** pass (URL normalization, search parser grammar, Netscape import/export round-trip).
- **13/13 Playwright e2e tests** pass (one per story) against the real app + real Chromium.
- Backend + frontend smoke-tested directly; offline MHTML capture confirmed working on a live page.

### Bugs found and fixed during implementation
1. **`better-sqlite3` aborts on process exit** in this Node 24.21 runtime → switched to the built-in **`node:sqlite`** (stable, no native build). Recorded as a plan deviation and saved to memory.
2. **Modal overlay intercepted all clicks** (`display:flex` overrode the `hidden` attribute) → fixed with `[hidden]{display:none!important}`.
3. **Nested transactions** (`import`/`bulk` calling `setTags`) crashed SQLite → made the transaction helper reentrant.
4. **Trailing-slash duplicates** weren't collapsing → broadened URL normalization (research §9 updated).

### Deviations from the approved plan (disclosed)
Recorded in `plan.md` → *Implementation Deviations*: the SQLite library swap, the broadened trailing-slash rule, and `PORT`/`BM_DATA_DIR` env vars used only to isolate the test run. Production `npm start` behavior is unchanged (`0.0.0.0:4000`, `<repo>/data`). These are environment-forced, intent-preserving changes — if you'd prefer, I can also fold them back into `research.md`/task text so every artifact matches verbatim.

### Runtime state for your review
- `.harness/app.json` is set (`kind: application`, port 4000, `npm start`).
- I stopped the previous (stale) server and **cleared the dev database**, so the broker will start the **fresh code with an empty collection** at `http://maker:4000` on your next review. The UI marks `data-harness-ready="true"` after the initial load (including the empty state).

The app is ready for you to review at **http://maker:4000**. Would you like me to walk through any specific flow, or make adjustments after you've tried it?
